comment: The document lists the jobs involved in managing health standards, but folds one big job inside another. Keeping the "translation tables" current, the ones that match local codes to global codes and ICD to SNOMED CT, is constant work with its own reviews and versions. The document raises this as a concern later but never lists it as its own job, so it is easy to under-resource.
